summary: Route one project thought to the correct knowledge layer without duplicating it or overstating its commitment.

outcomes: Route incoming work to todo, OpenSpec, changelog, or the skill improvement pipeline.
Preserve shared and private scope while avoiding duplicate project knowledge.

scenarios.title: Capture a hot project thought
scenarios.prompt: Use the capture-project-work skill to record this unrefined implementation thought without changing accepted product specifications.
scenarios.outcome: The thought is captured in the appropriate todo source with its scope and wording preserved.

scenarios.title: Record an accepted decision
scenarios.prompt: Use the capture-project-work skill to place this approved product decision in the correct project source without writing release history yet.
scenarios.outcome: The accepted intent is represented in OpenSpec and unrelated sources remain unchanged.
